exposure: Implementation of patient complaint management mechanisms/guidelines
outcome: Effectiveness of patient complaint management mechanisms
Challenges in implementing complaint mechanisms (infrastructure, awareness, processing, feedback, integration of lessons)
Contribution to quality improvement in maternal health services
cohort: Healthcare providers working in maternal, newborn, and child health services at Mkuranaga District Hospital in Tanzania.
finding: The implementation of patient complaint mechanisms for quality improvement in maternal health services was found to be ineffective, encountering challenges related to hospital infrastructure, complaint processing, feedback mechanisms, and the integration of lessons learned.
